Lead, coach, and develop a geographically dispersed team of HR Business Partners and HR leaders supporting both union and nonunion environments. Partner with Labor Relations to prepare for and participate in collective bargaining, grievance management, arbitration strategy, labor contract administration, and ongoing union-management relations. PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, or SHRM-SCP certification preferred. Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to connect HR strategies to operational performance, workforce productivity, and organizational outcomes. Experience using HR data, workforce analytics, and reporting to identify trends, communicate insights, and drive action. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with executives, field leaders, HR teams, and front-line employees. Proven ability to lead through ambiguity, drive organizational change, manage competing priorities, and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment. Courageous, inclusive, accountable leadership style with a strong commitment to employee experience, compliance, collaboration, and high performance.
